name: carbon-lite
description: CARBON Lite testing skills with an optional JavaScript evidence recorder and portable visual workspace. No MCP, OAuth, hosted service, or telemetry.

interface.longDescription: Jay helps assess software with eight bounded testing workflows: broad assessment, focused feature testing, issue hunting, accessibility, current-run evidence maps, disposable demos, help, and preferences. Includes a portable visual Studio report. Uses the coding agent's authorized browser and terminal tools; reports distinguish executed checks from proposed work. No MCP server, OAuth, telemetry, or hosted account. Source-available under PolyForm Perimeter 1.0.0. Not a certification or guarantee of correctness.
defaultPrompt: Assess this project with CARBON Lite.
Review these test results and explain the remaining risks.
